In this masterclass you compare excavated architectural spaces with structural temples.

Length, level and language are agreed with you. It can be given online or at your venue, as a single session or as part of a series.

What it covers

  • Excavated vs constructed
  • Cave sequence
  • Craft questions

How the time is spent

  1. Excavated vs constructed 30 min

    How rock-cut monuments differ from structural temples.

    You: photo distinction

  2. Cave sequence 60 min

    Badami, Elephanta and Ellora comparisons.

    You: sequence drawings

  3. Craft questions 30 min

    Working methods and conservation.

    You: method hypothesis

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.
